blocks.text: Medicines prepared in the pharmaceutical industry are of vital significance as regards human health. Chemistry unlocks the secrets behind how drugs truly work inside the body. A drug's safety limits and optimal dose range are two very crucial aspects of medicine. The knowledge of safety and the action of a drug ensures the safe absorption and action of a drug on the target disease. In this chapter, these aspects will be discussed.
